messages:
mike: heads-up — published js-sdk@2.3.1 and the edge sample app crashes on import. stacktrace shows ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for ./dist/index.cjs even though we shipped index.mjs

eva: same. reproduces in the playground and in our nextjs edge runtime test. looked at the package tarball, dist only has .mjs files and no .map files. package.json main points to ./dist/index.cjs 🤦

jordan: ugh that sounds like the build pipeline used the old consumer build where we switched to .mjs outputs but didn't update package.json/publish list. can you paste package.json from the tarball?

mike: here's the relevant bits from the published package (copied from npm pack contents):

```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/js-sdk",
  "version": "2.3.1",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "files": ["dist"]
}
```

mike: and dist contains index.mjs and index.d.ts, no index.cjs, no sourcemaps.

ci-bot: publish job #782 failed earlier with a warning but exited 0: `warning: some files matched .npmignore patterns` — looks like the pack filter excluded .map files and the cjs build step wasn't run in the pipeline. link: https://ci.internal/jobs/782

ryan: quick workaround for teams: pin to 2.3.0 or import the mjs entry explicitly for now. but we should hotfix the package.

sam: proposed fix: update release workflow to run `npm run build:cjs` when targeting dual outputs, ensure package.json main points to the shipped artifact, and add an assert step: `npm pack --dry-run` + validate manifest includes both .cjs and .map files. I'll open a PR.

jordan: also add a small smoke test that imports the published tarball in node and in the edge runner (esbuild/deno/next edge). It should catch require vs import mismatch.

eva: can we also surface this in the SDK's changelog or release notes so customers know why they might see ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND?

mike: yes — i'll unpublish 2.3.1 and republish a 2.3.2 with corrected package.json and maps. removing the bad package now.

sam: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/498 (adds pack-check, fixes main field, includes sourceMap upload). Assigning to @mike for publish.

jordan: small follow-up — let's add a GH Action that runs `node -e "require('./dist/index.cjs')"` as part of release matrix when cjs is listed in package.json. Will save us future mismatches.

mike: thanks all. lesson: dual ESM/CJS outputs require an explicit publish checklist. i added a short doc to devex/handbook for release steps. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: action: unpublish request queued for 2.3.1 — job #782 created rollback ticket INC-879

ryan: cheers. once 2.3.2 is out i'll update sample-app and playground to test on canary.

sam: leaving this thread — follow up in the PR comments.
